description: Cross-check of Option Alpha's Stage-1 candidate (SPY ORB60 long calls, fixed premium stop/target at 1:3: 20/60, 15/45, 10/30; PF 1.30-1.33 on Nov 2025-Jun 2026) and of OA's T1 (50/100, 0.50 delta) in the desk engine, on the part of DEV that Option Alpha never saw: 2024-08-01 to 2025-10-29 (period tag NOT_SEEN_BY_OA). OA rules: 0DTE, first breakout only per side (finished 1-minute close beyond the range), signal bars finishing by 12:00, next-bar entry, fixed stop and target as % of the debit on the option's price, nothing else (no breakeven, no if-flat, no time tightening), all out 15:25 (OA: 35 min before close). Calls and puts run separately, per symbol (SPY is the OA candidate; QQQ and IWM are context). Two exit mechanics: 'desk' = SPRINT_PLAN's fill rules (the base) and 'oa1m' = OA-LIKE (checked once a minute on the close, filled at the next minute's print). Contract: d40-55t45 (BS-EST delta 0.40-0.55 nearest 0.45; OA took the closest delta to 0.45 with no band, so band misses are skipped here and counted). 444 runs. Side rule pre-registered in two forms (no margin, and a 1% margin around the 20-day SMA), see the side_rule block. Two optimizer leads (VIX falling with proxy: VIXY, and the 0 to +/-0.75% open-gap side rule) in the optimizer_leads block; VIXY 1-minute stock bars come from tools/sprint_pull.py (stock bars only, no options). Not tuned: every pair and filter comes from the OA Stage-1 list.

blocks.name: oa_core
blocks.why: ORB60 calls and puts per symbol, the five Stage-1 pairs (20/20, 20/40, 20/60, 15/45, 10/30) plus T1's 50/100, both mechanics. 72 runs.

blocks.name: oa_t1_delta50
blocks.why: T1 itself: 50/100 with the 0.50-delta contract variant (d45-60t50: BS-EST 0.45-0.60 nearest 0.50), both mechanics. 12 runs.

blocks.name: orb_context
blocks.why: ORB30 and ORB15 as context (OA Stage 1 found nothing there), the five pairs, desk mechanics. 60 runs.

blocks.name: side_rule
blocks.why: OA's side rule, pre-registered in two forms: (a) sma20_side: calls only when the prior session's close is above its 20-day SMA (the 20 closes ending at that close), puts only when below; (b) sma20_side_1pct: calls only when that close is at least 1% above the SMA, puts only when at least 1% below, no trade in between. Each symbol's own closes (SPY = OA's rule). Five pairs, both mechanics; the unfiltered twin is in oa_core (random day-skip test). 120 runs.

blocks.name: event_skip
blocks.why: Skip FOMC statement days and CPI release days (sprint/events.py: FOMC from federalreserve.gov, CPI from BLS's 2024 and 2025 release calendars, both read 2026-10-31). Five pairs, both mechanics; twin in oa_core. 60 runs.

blocks.name: optimizer_leads
blocks.why: Two leads from Option Alpha's Strategy Optimizer on run 023 (it only filters existing trades, so they are in-sample leads), pre-registered here and tested on data OA never saw: (a) vixy_falling: 'VIX falling' (OA: VIX change -3 to -0.01) with PROXY: VIXY, because Alpaca has no VIX index: at the decision, VIXY's last finished 1-minute close is below VIXY's prior regular-session close; applied as stated to calls and puts alike (no put mirror was given); (b) gap_side_075: calls only when today's open vs the prior close is above 0% and at most +0.75%, puts only when below 0% and at least -0.75% (each symbol's own open). ORB60, five pairs, both mechanics; the unfiltered twins are in oa_core. 120 runs.
